citations.quote: A submission must not create duplicate jobs when the first submission succeeds but its acknowledgement fails.
A retry is permitted when the service rejected the first submission before creating a job.

rationale: The main rule forbids duplicate jobs when the first submission succeeds but its acknowledgement fails, so the commit_then_503 scenario checks for exactly one job and a returned job. The valid exception permits retry only when the service rejected the first submission before creating a job, which is the reject_then_503 case and is not asserted here.
